name: WARNING: Raw Jicama Sticks (Woody Fiber & High Inulin/FOS)
whyItWorks: Crispy Mexican turnip root served raw with lime and chili powder. Packed with indigestible woody cellulose and massive concentrations of inulin/fructooligosaccharides (FOS) that trigger severe gas distension and painful cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pass on raw jicama sticks on party platters and salad bars. Choose peeled steamed peeled zucchini or cucumber flesh without seeds.
